comparator.sourceNotes: The programme-specific Appendix I 2026–2027, printed pages 55–59 and cohort 9A201-2026, supplies the ordinary English full-time Tilburg sequence: 60 EC in each of three years. Every named course is represented separately; the third-year 30-EC mobility/minor window remains genuine open space. Old Testament: Torah and Prophetic Literature (U20074-B-6) carries 6 EC in the formal cohort table, correcting the general webpage's 3-EC display; there is no missing three-credit unit. Research and academic skills (12 EC) are embedded in named course weights and are not additional credit. Yellow-coded compulsory units rotate every two years and appear once in the specified cohort sequence. Ordinary Hebrew, Greek and Latin requirements are retained; Greek exemptions and replacement of Latin for an intended teacher-training master require the stated conditions/Board permission and are alternatives, not extra components. The merged registry target covers English Tilburg and Dutch Utrecht delivery plus part-time pacing. English full-time is an ordinary representative delivery, not an English-only target inferred from its translated name. The public reader was recorded as published on 14 September 2026; its general body retains a stale 2025–2026 effective-date clause, so the explicitly dated 2026 cohort appendix controls this reconstruction. Appendix and external allocation checked 2026-10-08; the external allocation and source conflict were rechecked on 2026-10-14; the settled comparator remains unchanged while the UCR judgment is independently reassessed.

comparatorRouteSelection.basis: The normalized target combines ordinary English Tilburg and Dutch Utrecht deliveries and full-/part-time modes. The ordinary English full-time Tilburg delivery provides an explicitly dated September 2026 cohort sequence for the same broad Theology bachelor, without selecting a shortened prior-degree pathway or the optional canonical-degree package. Translation of the registry display name does not establish an exclusive English target; delivery choice is independent of UCR fit.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The historical exception treated the absence of a full Theology discipline as dispositive. A bounded religion-and-worldviews closest response is coherent, and the target’s explicit justice, tolerance and responsibility questions support a materially different ethics-and-public-life route. The stable education minor was then assessed, but UCR has no coherent pedagogy, curriculum-design, supervised-school-practice or teacher-qualification sequence with which to construct a third 24-course programme. No further generator-eligible direction remains.

notes.text: Both UCR programmes are bounded related-field responses. They study belief, worldviews, meaning, ethics, justice and religion in cultural and public life, but do not reproduce Tilburg’s Catholic-theology identity, biblical source languages, exegesis, dogmatics, systematic and practical theology, liturgy, canon law, patristics or Theology thesis.

The public programme page still displays Old Testament: Torah and Prophetic Literature as 3 EC, while the adopted September 2026 cohort appendix gives U20074-B-6 as 6 EC. The formal 6-EC value remains controlling; the complete 180-EC comparator and neutral English full-time Tilburg route are preserved unchanged.
